title: Emergency Fund Guidelines
content: An emergency fund is a liquid cash reserve held in a High-Yield Savings Account (HYSA) or Money Market Fund. Most financial advisors recommend maintaining 3 to 6 months of essential living expenses before aggressively allocating capital to long-term stock market investments.

title: Risk Tolerance vs Risk Capacity
content: Risk tolerance is an investor's psychological willingness to endure market drawdowns without panic selling. Risk capacity is an investor's objective financial ability to take risks based on their time horizon, income stability, and debt obligations.
